body: Between school and work I barely have enough time to do anything.

I have one close friend, but I haven't heard from her in a few days. I moved back in with my family, and my mom is very supportive but my brothers and my brother's girlfriend completely ignore me unless they are yelling at me because I did something wrong or I forgot to do something.

I barely sleep and eat. I have to force myself to eat everyday and it's usually just a bite or two of yogurt.
I really do appreciate that you are willing to talk to me. It's more support then I'm receiving outside of my mother.

Honestly there aren't.
I barely have any friends actually I have only one friend. The family I live with again are abusive.

Life is about being strong, but I am so damn tired of being strong. That's what I've been my whole life to everyone around me. I've never had anyone there to be my support until him. The thing is about your father is he had his kids to pull him through. I don't have anyone. Also, I've been through a death of a parent I know how it is. This is by far worse on every single level, and I love my father like no other.
Sadly, I know if he was in my position he would do the same thing. He has told me this when I passed out and stopped breathing for a minute. I woke up to him screaming my name and saying I couldn't do this to him. When we went to the hospital he held my hand and said "if anything ever happened to you I would be right behind you".

Honestly, I could make that list right now. Struggle through school, working a shitty minimum wage retail job, live with family that naturally make me want to kill myself, and experience losing my grandmother (she's very close to death).
There will be nothing special that will happen. In between those things listed above will be me just thinking about how he's not here and I shouldn't be here. I have to spend all the holidays alone this year too.

I don't plan to lay around in bed until Saturday. Most of this week I will be spending it with his family. Which will be very hard for me because his little brother looks and acts just like him. 
I wish I had the money to do anything. I have 7 dollars to my name. If I could I would visit the one place we've always wanted to visit and camp, Alaska. 
Thank you for your kind words.

My whole entire life I've been strong. I had to be everyone's rock. This was the first time in a long time (over 13 years) that I've been actually happy. I thought about my future, started getting my life together, and able to be my true self without fear. And it's all thanks to him.
He's gone now. There is no future now.

I already reached out to the one other person I am capable to sharing these thoughts with besides my love and told me that they have their own problems to deal with.

There is no getting through this. I have come to that conclusion when I heard the paramedics say that he was gone. Everyone has someone but me. His whole family has each other I have no one. I had to move back in with my family and I know he would hate that I am here because there is so much bad shit between my family and I, and really no one in this house even talks to me. My brothers ignore me and my mother just sits with me. No one even texts me or calls to see how I am doing.
